items: Powerful Intel i5-12600H Processor -Featuring the 12th Gen Intel i5-12600H (12 Cores / 16 Threads, up to 4.5GHz), MALLRACE laptop delivers exceptional multitasking and processing power for complex work tasks. Paired with Intel Iris Xe Graphics, it renders vivid visuals for editing, streaming, and presentations. Ideal for professionals and students needing robust performance.

Expandable Memory & Massive Storage-Comes with 16GB DDR4 (dual slots, expandable up to 64GB at 3200MHz) for seamless multitasking. 512GB M.2 NVMe PCIe 3.0 SSD (dual M.2 slots) supports up to 4TB total storage, offering fast loading and ample file space. Equipped with an 54.72Wh lithium-polymer battery, this pc laptops provides all-day power for remote work, classes, or business trips.

Ultra-Portable Design & Immersive Full HD Display-Slim body and lightweight 1.65kg —Portable traditional laptop for commutes, business trips, or campus use. 15.6-inch 16:9 Full HD (1920*1080) 60Hz display delivers sharp text and vibrant colors, reducing eye strain during long sessions. 180° hinge design allows easy content sharing with colleagues/partners.

Stable Connectivity & Secure Video Communication-Equipped with WiFi 6 and BT5.2 for fast, stable wireless connections—perfect for remote work, online classes, and wireless peripheral pairing. 1MP webcam with a physical privacy switch protects your privacy after video calls. Full suite of ports (3 USB 3.2, HDMI 1.4, Type-C, etc.) supports versatile device connections for all scenarios

Windows 11 Laptop Computer & Reliable Performance-Preloaded with Windows 11, offering a secure, user-friendly OS with advanced productivity features. Powered by power supply for stable, consistent performance. The durable plastic build ensures long-term reliability, making it a trustworthy companion for daily work, study, and travel.
